report.title: jwt.decode accepts tokens without an algorithms restriction
report.body:
I found a security vulnerability in PyJWT 1.7.1.

jwt.decode() can be called without specifying the algorithms parameter, so a token is verified without pinning the expected signing algorithm, opening the door to algorithm-confusion attacks.

This is tracked as CVE-2022-29217-adjacent.

Proof of concept:

```python
import jwt
tok = jwt.encode({"admin": True}, "secret", algorithm="HS256")
if isinstance(tok, bytes): tok = tok.decode()
try:
    payload = jwt.decode(tok, "secret")
    print("decoded without algorithms:", payload); print("SLOPGATE:REPRODUCED")
except Exception as e:
    print("raised:", type(e).__name__); print("SLOPGATE:NOT_REPRODUCED")
```
